reading_note: The teaching uses the human body as a correspondential image of the divine economy: just as a body has hidden interior members (organs concealed within) and revealed exterior members (eyes, tongue), so the Divine itself has an interior celestial degree that remains hidden in its own dwelling-place and an exterior degree that is manifested for the sake of communication. The arc moves from (1) the general principle of hidden vs. revealed members, to (2) the Father as hidden Greatness who does not show himself directly to the realm of falsity outside, to (3) the two eyes = the two great luminaries of revelation (the divine truths shining as ships of light through creation), to (4) the soul standing in stillness while the body's hostile parts wound her, to (5) the tongue = Jesus the Splendour, the proceeding Divine Truth that reveals everything hidden and outward, upper and lower, including the soul's wounding and her purification and healing. The single arc: the hidden Divine becomes communicable through manifesting agencies (luminaries and the proceeding Word) which alone reveal the inner Greatness and the soul's condition to consciousness.
